blocks.text: “Hunger Games” stars Jennifer Lawrence and Josh Hutcherson brought back the “Hunger Games” nostalgia as they reunited at the premiere of the franchise’s latest installment, “Sunrise on the Reaping.” Lawrence and Hutcherson — who reprised their respective roles as Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark — attended the event held in New York on Monday, Nov. 16. The actress donned a black robe dress adorned with floral embroidery, while the latter looked dashing in an all-black suit and tie.
